    BONGA BHENGU OS / JARVIS INTELLIGENCE

    Think, research and plan with Jarvis.

    Use Jarvis without an API key

    Start a fashion business task in GitHub. Your report returns as a downloadable file.

    Run Jarvis in GitHub ↗
    1. Sign in to your GitHub account if asked.
    2. Click Run workflow. Leave cloud selected, then click the green Run workflow button.
    3. When the run finishes, download jarvis-local-report, extract it, and open the report below.

    This starts a task in GitHub. It does not automatically connect GitHub reports to your dashboard. The first model run still needs verification.

    Open my downloaded report ↓

    Ask for fashion design direction, brand positioning, campaign ideas, sourcing research or a sales plan. You review the evidence and decide what happens next.

    Checking AI connection…

    Connect your AI

    Use your existing bongabhenguwebsite secret key. Enter its full value here; the key name or masked value will not work.

    Checking private connection…

    Connect Jarvis AI

    Paste your full secret key into the private field. The key name alone does not connect AI.

    This sends one small AI request using your API account allowance.

    Your key is encrypted on the server, never shown after saving, and kept out of GitHub and report files. AI use follows your OpenAI account allowance.

    Cloud reports and downloaded reports

    Download and extract the GitHub report artifact, then open its .md file here. You can also paste a report. This reader works without the website AI connection.

    Reports stay in this page until you close it. A selected task is saved only when you add it to daily work.

    Specialists share the same protected Jarvis engine. Each prepares a draft when you ask; they do not run independently or publish automatically.

    Only your request and selected task context are sent to the AI provider. Keep customer contact and payment details out of your prompt.
